commit c11bc8136d84fce9eb010356dcbd8245f57c6a61
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@calypsoblue.org>
AuthorDate: Sat Sep 20 05:02:30 2025 +0000
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@calypsoblue.org>
CommitDate: Sat Sep 20 05:02:30 2025 +0000

    Bug 1893950 - json-c build config updates for RNP 0.18.0. r=dandarnell
    
    
    The updated cmake_define_files.py processing allows setting json_c_strtoll and
    json_c_strtoull correctly.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D265527

diff --git a/third_party/json-c/moz.build b/third_party/json-c/moz.build
index 6755176f4f2..d6c5b325ad9 100644
--- a/third_party/json-c/moz.build
+++ b/third_party/json-c/moz.build
@@ -21,12 +21,16 @@ else:
     DEFINES["_GNU_SOURCE"] = True
     DEFINES["CC"] = CONFIG["_CC"]
 
+    json_c_strtoll = CONFIG["JSON_C_STRTOLL"]
+    json_c_strtoull = CONFIG["JSON_C_STRTOULL"]
     GeneratedFile(
         "config.h",
         script="/comm/python/thirdroc/thirdroc/cmake_define_files.py",
         inputs=["cmake/config.h.in"],
         flags=[
-            "-DPACKAGE_URL=\"\""
+            "-DPACKAGE_URL=\"\"",
+            f"-Djson_c_strtoll={json_c_strtoll}",
+            f"-Djson_c_strtoull={json_c_strtoull}",
         ]
     )
 
diff --git a/third_party/openpgp.configure b/third_party/openpgp.configure
index 0ec5717adae..d4f6a7b1552 100644
--- a/third_party/openpgp.configure
+++ b/third_party/openpgp.configure
@@ -594,3 +594,31 @@ with only_when(in_tree_librnp):
             check_symbol_exists("strncasecmp", "strings.h", when=have_strings_h),
         )
         set_define("HAVE_STRDUP", check_symbol_exists("strdup", "string.h", when=have_string_h))
+
+        have_strtoll = check_symbol_exists("strtoll", "stdlib.h", when=have_stdlib_h)
+        have_strtoull = check_symbol_exists("strtoull", "stdlib.h", when=have_stdlib_h)
+        have__strtoi64 = check_symbol_exists("_strtoi64", "stdlib.h", when=have_stdlib_h)
+        have__strtoui64 = check_symbol_exists("_strtoui64", "stdlib.h", when=have_stdlib_h)
+
+        set_define("HAVE_STRTOLL", have_strtoll, when=have_stdlib_h)
+        set_define("HAVE_STRTOULL", have_strtoull, when=have_stdlib_h)
+        set_define("HAVE__STRTOI64", have__strtoi64, when=have_stdlib_h)
+        set_define("HAVE__STRTOUI64", have__strtoui64, when=have_stdlib_h)
+
+        @depends(have_strtoll, have__strtoi64, when=have_stdlib_h)
+        def json_c_strtoll(_have_strtoll, _have__strtoi64):
+            if _have_strtoll:
+                return "strtoll"
+            elif _have__strtoi64:
+                return "_strtoi64"
+
+        set_config("JSON_C_STRTOLL", json_c_strtoll, when=have_stdlib_h)
+
+        @depends(have_strtoull, have__strtoui64, when=have_stdlib_h)
+        def json_c_strtoull(_have_strtoull, _have__strtoui64):
+            if _have_strtoull:
+                return "strtoull"
+            elif _have__strtoui64:
+                return "_strtoui64"
+
+        set_config("JSON_C_STRTOULL", json_c_strtoull, when=have_stdlib_h)
title: Bug 1893950 - json-c build config updates for RNP 0.18.0. r=dandarnell
